quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 11.93 billion, up 44.20% YoY from RMB 8.27 billion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 946.32 million, up 43.10%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 915.41 million, up 45.37%; operating cash flow RMB 1.63 billion versus an outflow of RMB 640.94 million in 2024. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 2.22 billion, Q2 RMB 3.02 billion, Q3 RMB 3.29 billion, Q4 RMB 3.40 billion; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 150.19 million, Q2 RMB 222.18 million, Q3 RMB 346.60 million, Q4 RMB 227.35 million. Asset impairment of RMB 309.79 million, mainly inventory write-down provisions.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB 11.93 billion (+44.20%); net profit RMB 946.32 million (+43.10%); Q4 revenue RMB 3.40 billion

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue by product (annual report): data and access products RMB 8.46 billion, up 65.89%, 70.94% of revenue (61.67% in 2024), gross margin 21.85% (+4.02 points); transmission products RMB 3.41 billion, up 9.97%, 28.60% of revenue, gross margin 26.52% (-2.24 points). By region: domestic RMB 8.74 billion (+47.37%, 73.31% of revenue, gross margin 22.41%); overseas RMB 3.18 billion (+36.17%, 26.69% of revenue, gross margin 26.24%). Communications equipment manufacturing gross margin 23.31% (+1.22 points); all sales are direct.

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 volumes (annual report): sales volume 27,494.23 ten-thousand units (+9.57%), output 29,423.63 ten-thousand units (+5.70%), inventory 7,239.39 ten-thousand units (+36.34%), the inventory rise attributed to stocking up for market demand; inventory on the balance sheet RMB 5.75 billion (35.16% of total assets) versus RMB 3.96 billion a year earlier. Direct material cost rose 45.44% and direct labour 34.85%, both attributed to capacity increases; contract liabilities rose to RMB 431.12 million on larger sales.

R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D investment RMB 1.14 billion, up 48.21%, 9.52% of revenue (9.26% in 2024), of which 8.50% capitalised; R&D expense RMB 1.04 billion (+45.75%). R&D staff 1,391 (+14.20%), 28.13% of employees. In 2025 the company filed 186 domestic patent applications and 41 patents entered the PCT international phase. Main R&D projects: high-speed datacom optical modules for data-center customers' next-generation upgrades, next-generation PON and wireless fronthaul modules, and high-speed devices for telecom transmission networks.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1.14 billion (+48.21%), 9.52% of revenue; 1,391 R&D staff

quarterly_data.signal: Products and position (annual report): datacom optical modules cover 100G to 1.6T in QSFP, QSFP-DD and OSFP packages, including 400G VR4/DR4/FR4/LR4, 800G VR8, DR8, 2xFR4, 2xLR4, 800G DR8 LRO and 800G 2xFR4 LPO, and 1.6T DR8; transmission products include 100G/400G transceivers, fiber amplifiers, AWG, WSS and coherent devices; in-house laser chips (FP, DFB, EML, VCSEL), detector chips (PD, APD) and a SiP chip platform. The company cites Omdia: in Q4 2024 to Q3 2025 it ranked fifth in global optical components with a 5.9% share (datacom fourth at 5.9%, telecom fifth at 5.6%, access fourth at 7.6%). It says it remains a main supplier to leading domestic customers with a leading tender share, that growth came from AI-driven datacom module demand and domestic cloud providers' data-center build-out, that its annual shipments rank in the industry's top three, and that it kept raising overseas manufacturing and delivery capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: 100G to 1.6T datacom modules (1.6T DR8; 800G LRO/LPO); 5.9% global optical component share, fifth (Omdia)

quarterly_data.signal: Projects (annual report): the raised-fund high-end optical communication device production project reached its intended usable state on September 30, 2025, with RMB 84,088.73 ten-thousand invested (89.82% of RMB 93,623.27 ten-thousand) and benefits of RMB 69,658.23 ten-thousand realised in 2025 (expected benefit met); the high-end optoelectronic device R&D center project was 64.61% invested, with its usable date set for June 30, 2026. Construction in progress at year-end was RMB 79.54 million, including New Industrial Park Phase II (budget RMB 312,330,500.00, 19.60% complete).
quarterly_data.figure: production project usable September 30, 2025 (89.82% invested); 2025 benefit RMB 69,658.23 ten-thousand; Industrial Park Phase II 19.60%

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): domestically the company plans to consolidate core-customer cooperation and grow share, push scaled delivery of next-generation PON products, expand customers in domestic AI computing, keep its leading position in datacom optical modules and follow key industry-network projects; internationally it aims to seize opportunities in high-end optical modules and passive optical devices, win leading overseas customers, raise high-end product shipments and improve overseas delivery capacity. On technology it plans to complete its optical-chip process platform, keep increasing R&D in AI-computing optical modules, advance multi-rate product iteration and mass-production readiness, and pre-research next-generation ultra-high-speed devices. No numeric targets stated.
